notes.title: Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure is now FREE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004530/a9484b63aaff06fcfebe0aecb8756f40b7eeaee3.png[/img]

So... just to let you know, [b]Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure is now free[/b]. The game was made as my first full-length game as a tester project for learning to code. I thought people would buy it and no one did so it is now [b]free-to-play forever[/b].

It is a difficult game and controller support needs improvement however some people (I hope) will enjoy it as it is a lot better than many paid games out there I have played.

[u]TIP:[/u] Grind to unlock the store room, it makes things a lot easier and remember many [b]items stack[/b] meaning that if you get many of the same item, it will have a better effect.

notes.title: V1.01 added HINTS page in the HELP menu
notes.content:
Players told me it was bit difficult to know what to do in the beginning with no tutorial so helpful hints have been added to get you started. 

Open OPTIONS > HELP and the first page will be a list of tips to help you on your way in Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure.

Also, slightly decreased player movement speed (not much) as it was requested, just remember the game is intentionally difficult, it is not a game you can finish in 1 hour, probably more like 10-20 hours.

In regards to controller support, the game [b]can be played[/b]  with an Xbox controller however the game is [b]primarily intended to be played with mouse & keyboard[/b] and is much more difficult to play with a controller

The list of hints added is below

[list]
[*] destroy crates > collect scrap > use to unlock at camp
[*] items > scrap in inventory > right click menu
[*] quick slots > these help a lot > use them
[*] storeroom unlocked > store in chests > level end moved to store
[*] switches spawn other items > also spawn enemies & traps
[*] switches spawn teleporter crystals > travel back to camp
[*] unlock drill early on > destroy crates quicker
[*] unlock storeroom with scrap > items stored > next run
[*] unlock teleporter crystal & full hp potion good idea
[*] unlock weapon stand in camp after storeroom
[*] use xp earned > unlock book items > drop from crates
[/list]
